highlights_headline: Backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI .NET 9 packaging fix to the 3.119.x line.

bullets.detail: Backports the 26.0 library target and unversioned app TFM support so 3.119.x consumers can build against the newer Apple SDKs.
Fixes a packaging issue where the WinUI Projection DLL could not be found by .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support to the 3.119.x line
